children: Peoples Financial Services amended Thomas P. Tulaney's Supplemental Executive Retirement Plan to fund his normal retirement benefit through an annuity purchased by the Bank, effective August 28, 2026.
Former President; Participant in Supplemental Executive Retirement Plan
To provide a funding source for normal retirement benefit via purchase of an annuity contract
Amendment to May 31, 2012 SERP providing that if Mr. Tulaney survives the 20-year normal retirement benefit period, the Bank will make monthly lifetime payments equal to annuity contract amounts
